text:
sara_ng: Kicking off Hyperion-14B bring-up intake. We need a deployment + canary plan that covers hosted, Dedicated, and Private (VPC). Primary asks: quantization experiment matrix (fp16, int8, int4), eval pass on our QA prompts, latency/cost SLOs, and fallback options. Owners: TBD.

eli_k: I can lead quant experiments. Suggest matrix:
- fp16 baseline
- int8 + dynamic kv cache
- int4 w/ per-layer fallback (only last 8 layers in fp16)

maria_ops: For Dedicated we need capacity reservation numbers. Estimate initial qps: 30 rps steady, 150 peak burst. Can we warm KV cache on deploy?

dmitri_ml: @eli_k for evals let's run:
- LLMBench subset (qa/reasoning) for quality regression
- perf bench for 1k/2k seq lengths
- regression threshold: <=0.8% BLEU-drop equivalent or <1% rank loss on rerank tasks

cassie_se: Suggested canary split: 1% -> 5% -> 20% -> 50% over 24-48h with automated rollback on: error rate >1.5x baseline, p99 latency >1.5x target, or quality regression flagged by eval harness.

sara_ng: Put the smoke probes and guardrails in the runbook. Minimal thresholds:
- p50 < 90ms hosted (token-level)
- p99 < 450ms hosted
- Dedicated targets: p50 < 70ms, p99 < 320ms
- Cost per 1k tokens target within 1.3x of current raven-7b baseline

eli_k: Quick config snippet for canary traffic routing:
```
traffic_rules:
  - step: 1
    split: 0.01
    duration: 6h
  - step: 2
    split: 0.05
    duration: 12h
  - step: 3
    split: 0.2
    duration: 24h
```

maria_ops: For Private (VPC) customers: require policy docs + KMS integration tested. @devops-bot can you run the prereqs script on the staging VPC?

devops-bot: @maria_ops prereq-run queued. Command: `/infra prereq-check --vpc staging-hyperion`.

dmitri_ml: Add eval gating automated step: baseline_compare job that runs nightly and opens PR if delta > threshold. Also include human review step before promotion to 50%.

cassie_se: I'll owner the rollout sheet and callouts. Action items:
- [ ] Owners assigned (sara: PM)
- [ ] Quant matrix by eli (ETA 2d)
- [ ] Eval runs by dmitri (ETA 3d)
- [ ] Traffic policy + rollback by cassie (ETA 1d)
- [ ] Dedicated capacity estimate by maria (ETA 2d)

sara_ng: Thanks. If no major blockers I'll start the canary tomorrow morning UTC. Ping here with any blocker updates :thumbsup:

devops-bot: Canary pre-checks passed. All systems green. :white_check_mark:

eli_k: Started int8 runs on a8p nodes, posting logs to /runs/hyperion/int8.

maria_ops: Reserved 10 GPUs for initial canary on Dedicated. will adjust after smoke.

dmitri_ml: Nightly baseline_compare job added to CI. Will alert #eng-ml on failures.

cassie_se: Sheet link: https://docs.internal/redwood/hyperion-rollout (internal)

sara_ng: Great work team — keep updates short here during the rollout so we can act fast.
